interaction.prompt: You carry the puck over the blue line and the defender closes your gap. Tap the teammate who is the open layer to attack with.

feedback.right: Delay and drop to the trailing centre coming in with speed. You pull the defender to you and hand the puck to the open high layer for a clean look.
feedback.wrong: Neither winger is the read here. The far RW looks open but the defenceman has closed that cross-ice lane with an active stick, and dropping the puck back to the LD at the point hands away the speed you just built. Use the trailing centre coming in hot.

tip: Scan high ice as you cross the blue line. If the seam is covered, use the trailer with speed.
why: Recognizing the trailing layer turns a contested entry into a controlled attack instead of forcing a low-percentage cross-ice pass into a defender's stick.
